Multi-site asset management

For operators who run several sites and their equipment: office buildings, residences, shops, warehouses, public buildings, technical sites. Sites and equipment (category, make and model as free text, commissioning date, criticality), preventive maintenance with due dates calculated from the last visit, breakdowns from report to resolution, availability, average resolution time, cost per site and per equipment category, on-time preventive rate, alerts (overdue, equipment down for N days, site not visited for N months). Sortable, filterable list and a schematic map of the sites placed by their coordinates, with no online map service. CSV import and export for your spreadsheet, with blank templates.
